item.text:
### Three social posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We refuse to treat that outcome as an acceptable cost of technological progress.

2. We reject a future in which superintelligent AI becomes a tool for mass killing. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands. We demand prevention, not apologies afterward.

3. We will not trade thousands of lives for a race to build superintelligent AI. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a deadly disaster. We must act before that technology exists—not after the funerals.

### Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We state this plainly because the stakes demand plain language. We will not accept mass death as the price of innovation, or promises of future benefits as an excuse to ignore foreseeable harm. We demand enforceable limits on development, meaningful public oversight, and accountability for those making decisions that put lives at risk. We have a responsibility to prevent this disaster before it happens. We intend to meet that responsibility—and we ask you to stand with us.
